classic.title: Classic HDO (A+B+DP)
classic.description: Enter your postal code and A, B, DP codes from your electricity meter. Enter prices in your Home Assistant currency ({currency}) per kWh.

hdo_codes.title: HDO Commands (codes)
hdo_codes.description: Enter your postal code and HDO codes separated by comma (e.g. 405,406,410). Enter prices in your Home Assistant currency ({currency}) per kWh.

smart.title: Smart Meter
smart.description: Select your smart meter code (e.g. ACd4510). You can type into the field to filter the list. The list is loaded from EG.D.

smart_settings.title: Smart Meter {code}
smart_settings.description: Set the relay schedule (if the code has several), prices and colors. Enter prices in your Home Assistant currency ({currency}) per kWh. For direct heating / storage the relay labelled PV is usually correct.

data_description.schedule: The schedule that defines your low tariff. Schedules are not combined.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to EGD Distribuce API
error.invalid_psc: Postal code not found in EGD database
error.unknown_code: The code was not found in the EG.D list. Select a code from the list.

abort.already_configured: This configuration is already set up
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to download the code list from EG.D. Try again later.

smart_schedule_default.title: Smart meter {code}: schedule chosen automatically
smart_schedule_default.description: Code {code} has several relay schedules and none was selected. "{schedule}" is used. If that is not yours, remove the integration and add it again with your own choice.

smart_schedule_missing.title: Smart meter {code}: saved schedule is no longer offered by EG.D
smart_schedule_missing.description: The saved relay schedule is no longer in the EG.D data. "{schedule}" is used temporarily. Remove the integration and add it again with a new choice.

init.title: Adjust Settings
init.description: Change tariff prices and colors. Enter prices in your Home Assistant currency ({currency}) per kWh.
